description: This is a Java interface defining a contract for retrieving images related to a merchant store. It declares a method to fetch images based on store code and content type.

classes.name: ImageGet
classes.description: An interface that specifies a method for obtaining a list of output content files representing images for a merchant store.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of images associated with a merchant store based on store code and content type, potentially throws a ServiceException.
